content: {"episode_id":"ep-05043","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and underlying nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency. Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is indicated to evaluate atrial fibrillation burden and assess for significant pauses or tachy-brady syndrome. These documented clinical indications support this medical necessity appeal of the CO-197 denial, with authorization status recorded as missing."}
